timeline.frame_rates: any; NTSC as exact N/1001; drop-frame at 29.97 and 59.94 only

tools.description: A plan (nle-bridge/timeline@1, the agent's project IR, an ffmpeg-skill render project, or an OTIO / FCP7 XML / EDL) as editor timelines: OTIO, FCP7 XML (Premiere), CMX 3600 EDL, and an SRT sidecar for captions. A beat grid adds bar / beat markers; --dissolves writes cross dissolves centred on the cut. What a format cannot carry is a warning, never dropped

A conform package: the timelines, the plan as JSON, a relink manifest (path, size, sha256, start timecode, length, fps, picture size, and the ranges used of every media file) and a file manifest, in a folder and optionally a zip; media copied in only with --copy-media

Round trip: the timeline an NLE gives back (OTIO, FCP7 XML or EDL) against the plan: clips changed (moved, trimmed, slipped, level, transition), added (split_from on a razor cut) and removed, Premiere's per-channel copies of a stereo clip folded into one, cut points moved in frames, markers added / removed / changed, and with a beat grid how many frames each cut sits off the nearest beat. Optionally the returned timeline as a new plan version
Any accepted input (plan, project IR, render project, OTIO, FCP7 XML, EDL) as nle-bridge/timeline@1
